additional_info.subject: First Entry
additional_info.body:
We would like to have the EcoG logs retrived from these chargers for further investigation.
This is a public charger, so any vehicle can charger.
We had a Scania P25 Gen1 (truck ) try to charge at a public SiCharge D, but it failed, was wondering if you would be able to retrieve the EcoG logs? Chargers are 170000340 and 170000343
We already have assess the following, thus requires V2G logs to confirm beliefs.
Charger:  170000343
Vehicle plugged in at 2024-08-05T22:16 UTC
2024-08-05T22:16 OCPP: Received command: RemoteStartTransaction - idTag:0027009,connectorId:3
Remote start was received and session starting its checks, but failed with communication between vehicle and charger (requested additional logs) PreCharge Voltage too low/high
Another remote start was sent.
2024-08-05T22:17 OCPP: Received command: RemoteStartTransaction - idTag:0027010,connectorId:3
This was accepted and started charging, then a remotestoptransaction was received from the OCPP backend.
2024-08-05T22:18OCPP: Received command: RemoteStopTransaction - transactionId:27011
This stopped the charger session.
We need to check with CPO what triggered this remotestop from their side.
Charger:170000340
Vehicle was plugged in at 2024-08-05T22:25:54 UTC
Then the vehicle sent through the MAC address for autocharge, this was blocked and did not start the session and no remote session was requested.
2024-08-05T22:26 OCPP:Send command: Authorize - IdTag:VID:[Dummy MAC]
2024-08-05T22:26 OCPP: Received result: Authorize idTagInfo:status:Blocked,parentIdTag:U0001529
